rationale: The plant models the robot's motion and perception capabilities, separating motion commands from sensor outcomes. The specification enforces an always-turn-right, safe exploration policy: move forward only when the path is clear, and rotate clockwise in response to any obstacle event. Recovery states only allow rotate_clockwise, and return to forward progress as soon as path_clear is observed. No other controllable actions are enabled. All uncontrollable events are handled in every state, and the automata are deterministic.
strategy: Separate plant automata for motion (G1) and perception (G2)
Specification E1 binds path_clear to move_forward and any obstacle to rotate_clockwise, with recovery states that only enable rotate_clockwise and return to forward as soon as path_clear occurs

G.name: G1
G.purpose: Robot motion actuator: executes move_forward and rotate_clockwise commands.

G.name: G2
G.purpose: Robot perception: emits uncontrollable events for path clearance and obstacles.

E.name: E1
E.purpose: Safe always-turn-right exploration: move forward only if path is clear; rotate clockwise on any obstacle; recovery states only allow rotate_clockwise and return to forward on path_clear.
